name: UNSD Energy Statistics Database (DF_UNDATA_ENERGY)
contents: Annual energy commodity balances for State of Palestine: electricity, petroleum products, solar, biofuels, with production/imports/exports/stock/final-consumption/losses transactions. Verified: 4,567 observations for REF_AREA 275, 1990-2024, 15 commodities x 15 transactions.

license.name: UNdata Terms of Use (attribution-only, open)
license.quote: All data and metadata provided on UNdata's website are available free of charge and may be copied freely, duplicated and further distributed provided that UNdata is cited as the reference.

traps: REF_AREA must be numeric 275 (.PSE returns HTTP 500). COMMODITY/TRANSACTION are opaque codes needing DSD_ENERGY codelists. UNIT_MULT=3 applies. CONVERSION_FACTOR column sits beside OBS_VALUE. Legacy DownloadHandler.ashx returns headers with zero rows; only SDMX REST works.

name: UN 2720 Mechanism Monitoring & Tracking Dashboard
contents: Per-consignment aid verification for Gaza as daily+monthly series: trucks, pallets, tonnage arrived/collected/delivered/looted, by 10 aid categories and 28 organisations. Verified: 368 daily observations 2025-05-21 to 2026-08-02; 29,645 delivered trucks, 604,550 pallets, 419,988 tonnes; looted series 7,229 trucks / 84,521 tonnes.

license.name: No explicit licence; UN Terms of Use floor
license.quote: The United Nations grants permission to Users to visit the Site and to download and copy the information ... for the User's personal, non-commercial use

fills_gap: THE live successor to the dead UNRWA aid-truck series — starts after UNRWA's ended
traps: Undocumented internal dashboard endpoints, no stability guarantee — snapshot daily. Date params silently ignored: full cumulative arrays every call, diff snapshots. GET only. fetchArrived/Intercepted/Offloaded return empty. Org names unnormalised duplicates. Personal-use licence posture like OCHA.

name: UNESCO Institute for Statistics (UIS) Data API
contents: Education, science/tech, culture statistics for Palestine. Verified: single unauthenticated call returned 38,364 observations across 3,604 indicators, 1970-2025.

license.name: CC BY-SA 4.0
license.quote: The work of the UIS is licensed under the Creative Commons Attribution-ShareAlike 4.0 International license.

fills_gap: deep 1970-1999 era coverage + a real education category
traps: ShareAlike viral on derived tables. Bare numeric indicatorIds need metadata join. 4.2MB single JSON, no pagination. Distinct from the heritage register already held.

name: ILOSTAT SDMX (short-term labour indicators)
contents: LFS-derived employment, unemployment, participation, hours, earnings for Palestine, annual + quarterly, sex/age disaggregated. Verified: 2025-Q1 total unemployment 300,228 persons.

license.name: CC BY 4.0 (datasets published on/after 3 May 2023)
license.quote: As of 3 May 2023, databases and datasets together with the accompanying referential metadata are covered by the Creative Commons CC BY 4.0 licence.

fills_gap: labour beyond annual + quarterly economic pulse
traps: CRITICAL: quarterly PSE series carries NOTE_SOURCE 'Geographical coverage: Excluding Gaza Strip' — post-2023 quarterly is West Bank only, note must ride every row. Only sdmx.ilo.org works. Six-dimension SDMX key; wrong count = silent empty. Pre-May-2023 datasets not auto-CC.

name: UN World Population Prospects 2024
contents: Annual demographics for State of Palestine from 1950: population, births, deaths, life expectancy, IMR, net migration. Verified: 152 PSE rows 1950-2101; 1950 population 940,731, IMR 142.53, net migration -17,881.

license.name: Not resolvable at source; un.org ToU floor
license.quote: personal, non-commercial use (un.org Terms of Use — WPP-specific licence pages 404/JS-only)

fills_gap: the ONLY source found putting real annual numbers into the 1950-1966 era hole
traps: Pre-1967 figures are a modelled back-cast of today's territory, not archival observation — must be labelled estimates. Truncate projections at current year. dataportalapi now 401s; only bulk gzipped CSV usable (16MB global, filter ISO3=PSE).

name: IPC Global Acute Food Insecurity — subnational Palestine (via HDX HAPI)
publisher: IPC partnership via OCHA HDX HAPI
contents: IPC acute food insecurity phases for Gaza and West Bank at admin2: population and fraction in each phase 1-5 per analysis window. Verified: 538 PSE rows across 16 analysis periods 2023-11 to 2026-07.
fills_gap: subnational famine severity — the closest openly-licensed authoritative severity series for Gaza
traps: current/projected/second_projected rows per window under ipc_type — filter one or triple-count. admin0/1/2 rows coexist — summing across levels double-counts. HAPI needs base64 app_identifier. HAPI humanitarian-needs/idps/operational-presence are EMPTY for PSE — do not budget for those.

name: UN Comtrade (reporter 275)
contents: Merchandise trade with Palestine as reporter: exports/imports by HS commodity and partner, annual + monthly. Verified values: 2022 total exports USD 1,525,158,846; monthly record for 202401.

license.name: UN Comtrade custom licence — could not be quoted at source
license.quote: re-dissemination of data 'as is' restricted to Premium Pro subscribers per Comtrade policy; licence pages are JS-only shells; un.org ToU floor applies

traps: LEGAL RISK: re-dissemination restriction — verify licence before any ingest. Preview endpoint caps 500 rows. Mirror statistics file the same trade under partner codes. ISO fields null in preview.

name: UNICEF Data Warehouse (SDMX)
contents: Cross-sector child indicators, 42 dataflows. Verified: 8,344 PSE rows, 245 indicators, with survey provenance, confidence bounds, sample sizes.

license.name: Not resolvable — UNICEF legal pages 403 programmatic clients

traps: Licence needs a manual browser read. GLOBAL_DATAFLOW re-publishes WHO GHO/UIS/WPP — dedupe on DATA_SOURCE or double-count against 184 held WHO codes. Mixes observations with projections to 2100. PT_CONFLICT dataflow returns 'No data' for PSE.

name: UN SDG Global Database API (geoAreaCode 275)
contents: SDG indicator series with dimension attributes. Verified: EG_ACS_ELEC 75 observations electricity access urban/rural from 2000; VC_DSR_MTMP 45 observations disaster deaths from 2006.
fills_gap: mostly duplicates custodian agencies already held; disaster-risk/governance series genuinely new
traps: Republication layer — dedupe against WHO/WDI/ILOSTAT. No bulk per-country endpoint. Naive parse loses urban/rural/sex context. Nature flags (C/CA/E/M) must be preserved.
